Translation: Peace be upon Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah
The Seal of the Prophets
And the Master of the Messengers
And the Chosen One of the Lord of the Worlds
The Trustee of Allah upon His revelation
And His determined commands
The Seal of what has passed
And the Opener of what is to come
And the Guardian over all of that
And may Allah's mercy and blessings be upon him
And His blessings and greetings
Peace be upon the Prophets of Allah and His Messengers
And His close angels
And His righteous servants
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful
And Master of the Successors
And Inheritor of the knowledge of the Prophets
And Guardian of the Lord of the Worlds
And my Master and the Master of the Believers
And may Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you

Arabic text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O my Master, O Commander of the Faithful
O Trustee of Allah on His earth
And His ambassador among His creation
And His conclusive proof over His servants

Arabic text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا دِيْنَ اللَّهِ الْقَوِيمَ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O straight religion of Allah
And His straight path
Peace be upon you, O Great News
About which they differ
And concerning which they will be questioned
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful
You believed in Allah while they were polytheists
And you confirmed the truth while they were deniers
And you strived in the way of Allah while they held back
And you worshipped Allah with sincere devotion
Patient and hopeful of reward until certainty came to you
Indeed, may Allah's curse be upon the oppressors
Peace be upon you, O Master of the Muslims
And Leader of the Believers
And Imam of the God-fearing
And Leader of the resplendent ones with bright foreheads
And may Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you
I bear witness that you are the brother of the Messenger of Allah
And his successor and the inheritor of his knowledge
And his trustee over his law
And his caliph among his community
And the first to believe in Allah
And confirm what was revealed to His Prophet

Arabic text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَلَّغَ عَنِ اللَّهِ مَا أَنْزَلَهُ فِيكَ
Translation: And I bear witness that he conveyed from Allah what was revealed concerning you
So he proclaimed His command

Arabic text: وَأَوْجَبَ عَلَى أُمَّتِهِ فَرْضَ طَاعَتِكَ وَوِلَايَتِكَ
Translation: And made obligatory upon his community the duty of obeying you and your guardianship
And secured for them the pledge of allegiance to you
And made you closer to the believers than themselves
As Allah had made him likewise
Then he called upon Allah the Exalted as witness over them
And said: "Have I not conveyed?"
They replied: "O Allah, yes"
Then he said: "O Allah, bear witness"

Arabic text: وَكَفَىٰ بِكَ شَهِيدًا وَحَاكِمًا بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ
Translation: And You are sufficient as a witness and a judge between the servants

Arabic text: فَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ جَاحِدَ وِلَايَتِكَ بَعْدَ الْاِقْرَارِ
Translation: May Allah curse those who deny your guardianship after acknowledging it
And those who break their covenant with you after the pledge

Arabic text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ وَفَيْتَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ
Translation: And I bear witness that you fulfilled the covenant of Allah the Exalted

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى مُوفٍ لَكَ بِعَهْدِهِ
Translation: And that Allah the Exalted will fulfill His covenant with you

Arabic text: وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهُ اللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
Translation: And whoever fulfills what he has covenanted with Allah, He will grant him a great reward
And I bear witness that you are the true Commander of the Faithful
About whose guardianship the revelation spoke

Arabic text: وَأَخَذَ لَكَ الْعَهْدَ عَلَى الْأُمَّةِ بِذٰلِكَ الرَّسُوْلُ
Translation: And for whom the Messenger secured the covenant from the community
And I bear witness that you and your uncle and your brother
Are those who bartered with Allah your own souls
So Allah revealed concerning you

Arabic text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ
Translation: "Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties
In exchange for Paradise

Arabic text: يُقَاتِلُونَ فِيْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ
Translation: They fight in the cause of Allah, so they kill and are killed

Arabic text: وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا فِيْ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْاِنْجِيلِ وَالْقُرْآنِ
Translation: As a promise binding upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Quran
And who is more faithful to his covenant than Allah?
So rejoice in your transaction which you have concluded
And that is the great attainment
The repentant, the worshippers
The praisers, the travelers
Those who bow, those who prostrate
Those who enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong
And those who observe the limits of Allah. And give good tidings to the believers"
I bear witness, O Commander of the Faithful

Arabic text: أَنَّ الشَّاكَّ فِيكَ مَا آمَنَ بِالرَّسُولِ الْاَمِينِ
Translation: That whoever doubts you has not believed in the Trustworthy Messenger

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ الْعَادِلَ بِكَ غَيْرَكَ عَانِدٌ عَنِ الدِّينِ الْقَوِيمِ
Translation: And whoever equates others with you has deviated from the straight religion
Which the Lord of the Worlds has chosen for us
And perfected through your guardianship on the day of Ghadeer

Arabic text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ الْمَعْنِيُّ بِقَوْلِ الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: And I bear witness that you are the one intended by the words of the Mighty, the Merciful
"And this is My path, straight, so follow it

Arabic text: وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوْا السُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ
Translation: And do not follow other ways, for they will separate you from His way"

Arabic text: ضَلَّ وَاللَّهِ وَأَضَلَّ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ سِوَاكَ
Translation: By Allah, those who follow other than you have gone astray and misled others
And those who oppose you have deviated from the truth
O Allah, we have heard Your command
And we obey and follow Your straight path
So guide us, our Lord

Arabic text: وَلَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا إِلَى طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us to obey You
And make us among those who are grateful for Your blessings

Arabic text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَزَلْ لِلْهَوَى مُخَالِفًا
Translation: And I bear witness that you have always opposed desires
And allied yourself with piety
Able to suppress anger
Pardoning and forgiving people
Displeased when Allah is disobeyed
And pleased when Allah is obeyed
Acting according to what was entrusted to you
Guarding what you were asked to preserve
Protecting what was entrusted to you
Conveying what you were charged with
Awaiting what you were promised
And I bear witness that you never retreated out of fear
Nor held back from claiming your right out of anxiety

Arabic text: وَلَا أَحْجَمْتَ عَنْ مُجَاهَدَةِ غَاصِبِيكَ نَاكِلًا
Translation: Nor refrained from fighting those who usurped your rights out of cowardice

Arabic text: وَلَا أَظْهَرْتَ الرِّضَا بِخِلاَفِ مَا يُرْضِيْ اللَّهَ مُدَاهِنًا
Translation: Nor showed contentment with what displeases Allah out of hypocrisy

Arabic text: وَلَا وَهَنْتَ لِمَا أَصَابَكَ فِيْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
Translation: Nor weakened when you were afflicted in the way of Allah

Arabic text: وَلَا ضَعُفْتَ وَلَا اسْتَكَنْتَ عَنْ طَلَبِ حَقِّكَ مُرَاقِبًا
Translation: Nor did you grow feeble or submissive in seeking your right out of apprehension
Allah forbid that you should be like that
Rather, when you were wronged, you sought reward from your Lord
And entrusted your affair to Him
And you reminded them, but they did not remember
And you admonished them, but they did not heed
And you warned them of Allah, but they did not fear
And I bear witness that you, O Commander of the Faithful
Strived in the way of Allah with true striving
Until Allah called you to His presence
And took you to Himself by His choice
And made your enemies bear the argument against themselves by killing you
So that the proof might be established against them

Arabic text: مَعَ مَا لَكَ مِنَ الْحُجَجِ الْبَالِغَةِ عَلَى جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِهِ
Translation: Along with the conclusive proofs you already had over all His creation
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful
You worshipped Allah sincerely
And strived in the way of Allah patiently
And sacrificed yourself seeking reward
And acted according to His Book
And followed the Sunnah of His Prophet
And established prayer
And gave the zakat
And enjoined what is right
And forbade what is wrong to the best of your ability
Seeking what is with Allah
Desiring what Allah has promised
Not deterred by calamities
Not weakened by hardships
Not holding back from any battle

Arabic text: أَفِكَ مَنْ نَسَبَ غَيْرَ ذٰلِكَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Those who attribute otherwise to you are liars
And have fabricated falsehood against you
And woe to those who turned away from you

Arabic text: لَقَدْ جَاهَدْتَ فِيْ اللَّهِ حَقَّ الْجِهَادِ
Translation: Indeed, you strived in the way of Allah with true striving
And endured harm with patient endurance seeking reward
And you were the first to believe in Allah
And pray to Him and strive for Him
And you showed your face openly in the abode of polytheism
When the earth was filled with misguidance
And Satan was worshipped openly

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الْقَائِلُ لَا تَزِيدُنِيْ كَثْرَةُ النَّاسِ حَوْلِيْ عِزَّةً
Translation: And you are the one who said: "The multitude of people around me does not increase my honor
Nor does their dispersal from me cause me loneliness

Arabic text: وَلَوْ أَسْلَمَنِيَ النَّاسُ جَمِيعًا لَمْ أَكُنْ مُتَضَرِّعًا
Translation: And if all people abandoned me, I would not be humbled"
You sought protection in Allah and were strengthened
And you preferred the Hereafter over this world, so you lived ascetically
And Allah supported you and guided you
And purified you and chose you
Your actions were never contradictory
Nor were your words inconsistent
Nor did your conditions change

Arabic text: وَلَا ادَّعَيْتَ وَلَا افْتَرَيْتَ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
Translation: You never made false claims nor fabricated lies against Allah
Nor were you greedy for worldly gains
Nor were you defiled by sins

Arabic text: وَلَمْ تَزَلْ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكَ
Translation: You were always upon clear evidence from your Lord
And certainty in your affairs

Arabic text: تَهْدِيْ إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
Translation: Guiding to the truth and to a straight path
I bear witness with a true testimony
And I swear by Allah a truthful oath

Arabic text: أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا وَ آلَهُ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ سَادَاتُ الْخَلْقِ
Translation: That Muhammad and his family, may Allah's blessings be upon them, are the masters of creation
And that you are my master and the master of the believers
And that you are the servant of Allah and His guardian
And the brother of the Messenger and his successor and his inheritor
And that he is the one who said to you:

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْ بَعَثَنِيْ بِالْحَقِّ مَا آمَنَ بِيْ مَنْ كَفَرَ بِكَ
Translation: "By Him Who sent me with the truth, no one has believed in me who disbelieves in you
And no one has acknowledged Allah who denies you
Indeed, those who turn away from you have gone astray

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَهْتَدِ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا إِلَيَّ مَنْ لَا يَهْتَدِيْ بِكَ
Translation: And none can be guided to Allah or to me who is not guided by you"
And this is the saying of my Lord, Mighty and Majestic:

Arabic text: وَإِنِّيْ لَغَفَّارٌ لِمَنْ تَابَ وَ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا
Translation: "And indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness
And then is guided" to your guardianship
My master, your excellence is not hidden
And your light cannot be extinguished
And whoever denies you is the most unjust and wretched
My master, you are the proof over the servants
And the guide to the right path
And the provision for the Hereafter

Arabic text: مَوْلَايَ لَقَدْ رَفَعَ اللَّهُ فِيْ الْأُوْلَى مَنْزِلَتَكَ
Translation: My master, Allah has elevated your rank in this world
And raised your degree in the Hereafter

Arabic text: وَبَصَّرَكَ مَا عَمِيَ عَلَى مَنْ خَالَفَكَ
Translation: And made clear to you what was obscure to those who opposed you

Arabic text: وَحَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَوَاهِبِ اللَّهِ لَكَ
Translation: And they stood between you and Allah's gifts to you
May Allah curse those who violated your sanctity
And those who diverted the truth from you
And I bear witness that they are the losers
Those whose faces the Fire will scorch
And they will grimace therein

Arabic text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ مَا أَقْدَمْتَ وَلَا أَحْجَمْتَ
Translation: And I bear witness that you never proceeded nor held back
Nor spoke nor remained silent
Except by the command of Allah and His Messenger
You said: "By Him in Whose Hand is my soul

Arabic text: لَقَدْ نَظَرَ إِلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, looked at me
As I was striking with the sword bravely, and he said:

Arabic text: يَا عَلِيُّ أَنْتَ مِنِّيْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوْسَى
Translation: 'O Ali, you are to me in the position of Aaron to Moses
Except that there is no prophet after me

Arabic text: وَأُعْلِمُكَ أَنَّ مَوْتَكَ وَحَيَاتَكَ مَعِيْ وَعَلَى سُنَّتِي
Translation: And I inform you that your death and your life will be with me and upon my Sunnah'
By Allah, I have neither lied nor been lied to
Neither have I gone astray nor been led astray

Arabic text: وَلَا نَسِيتُ مَا عَهِدَ إِلَيَّ رَبِّي
Translation: Nor have I forgotten what my Lord covenanted with me

Arabic text: وَإِنِّيْ لَعَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّيْ بَيَّنَهَا لِنَبِيِّهِ
Translation: And indeed, I am upon clear evidence from my Lord which He made clear to His Prophet
And the Prophet made clear to me

Arabic text: وَإِنِّيْ لَعَلَى الطَّرِيقِ الْوَاضِحِ أَلْفِظُهُ لَفْظًا
Translation: And indeed, I am upon the clear path, speaking it clearly"
You spoke the truth, by Allah, and you said what is right

Arabic text: فَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ سَاوَاكَ بِمَنْ نَاوَاكَ
Translation: May Allah curse those who equate your adversaries with you
And Allah, exalted be His name, says:

Arabic text: هَلْ يَسْتَوِيْ الَّذِيْنَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُون
Translation: "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?"

Arabic text: فَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ عَدَلَ بِكَ مَنْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وِلايَتَكَ
Translation: May Allah curse those who equate with you those whom Allah has obligated to follow your guardianship
For you are the guardian of Allah
And the brother of His Messenger
And the defender of His religion
And the one about whose excellence the Quran speaks
Allah the Exalted said:

Arabic text: وَفَضَّلَ اللَّهُ الْمُجَاهِدِيْنَ عَلَى الْقَاعِدِيْنَ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
Translation: "Allah has preferred the strivers with their wealth and their lives over those who sit back, by a great reward
Degrees from Him and forgiveness and mercy
And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful"
And Allah the Exalted said:

Arabic text: أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ الْحَاجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ
Translation: "Do you consider providing water to pilgrims and maintaining the Sacred Mosque

Arabic text: كَمَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَجَاهَدَ فِيْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
Translation: Equal to one who believes in Allah and the Last Day and strives in the way of Allah?
They are not equal in the sight of Allah
And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people
Those who have believed and emigrated

Arabic text: وَجَاهَدُوْا فِيْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ
Translation: And strived in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives
Are greater in rank in the sight of Allah
And it is those who are the attainers
Their Lord gives them good tidings of mercy from Him and approval
And of gardens for them wherein is enduring pleasure
Abiding therein forever
Indeed, Allah has with Him a great reward"
I bear witness that you are the one specially praised by Allah
The one sincere in obedience to Allah
You never sought a substitute for guidance
And never associated anyone in the worship of your Lord
And that Allah the Exalted answered His Prophet

Arabic text: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِيكَ دَعْوَتَهُ
Translation: May Allah bless him and his family, regarding his supplication for you

Arabic text: ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ بِإِظْهَارِ مَا أَوْلاَكَ لْأُمَّتِهِ
Translation: Then He commanded him to make known to his community what He had bestowed upon you
To elevate your status
And to declare your proof
And to refute falsehoods
And to cut off excuses
But when he feared the trial of the corrupt
And was cautious regarding you because of the hypocrites
The Lord of the Worlds revealed to him:

Arabic text: يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ
Translation: "O Messenger, announce that which has been revealed to you from your Lord

Arabic text: وَإِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ
Translation: And if you do not, then you have not conveyed His message
And Allah will protect you from the people"
So he took upon himself the burden of the journey
And arose in the scorching heat of midday
He delivered a sermon and made all hear
And called out and proclaimed
Then he asked them all together
And said: "Have I conveyed?"
They said: "O Allah, yes"
He said: "O Allah, bear witness"

Arabic text: ثُمَّ قَالَ  أَلَسْتُ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ
Translation: Then he said: "Am I not more worthy of the believers than their own selves?"
They said: "Yes"
Then he took your hand and said:

Arabic text: مَنْ كُنْتُ مَوْلاَهُ فَهٰذَا عَلِيٌّ مَوْلاَهُ
Translation: "Whoever I am his master, this Ali is his master
O Allah, befriend whoever befriends him
And be an enemy to whoever is hostile to him
And support whoever supports him
And forsake whoever forsakes him"

Arabic text: فَمَا آمَنَ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ
Translation: But only a few believed in what Allah revealed concerning you through His Prophet
And it only increased most of them in arrogance

Arabic text: وَلَقَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِيكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَهُمْ كَارِهُونَ
Translation: And Allah the Exalted had previously revealed concerning you, while they were averse:
"O you who have believed
Whoever of you should renounce his religion

Arabic text: فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيْ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُ
Translation: Allah will bring forth a people He will love and who will love Him
Humble toward the believers
Powerful against the disbelievers
They strive in the cause of Allah
And do not fear the blame of a critic

Arabic text: ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ
Translation: That is the favor of Allah; He bestows it upon whom He wills
And Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing

Arabic text: إِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَالَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا
Translation: Your guardian is none but Allah and His Messenger and those who have believed
Who establish prayer
And give zakah while they bow in prayer

Arabic text: وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا
Translation: And whoever takes Allah and His Messenger and those who have believed as allies
Indeed, the party of Allah - they will be the predominant"

Arabic text: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ
Translation: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and we follow the Messenger
So register us among the witnesses

Arabic text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
Translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us
And grant us from Yourself mercy
Indeed, You are the Bestower

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هٰذَا هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
Translation: O Allah, we know that this is the truth from You
So curse whoever opposed it and was arrogant
And denied it and disbelieved in it

Arabic text: وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا أَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَنْقَلِبُونَ
Translation: And those who have wronged will come to know to what return they will return
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful
And Master of the Successors
And the First of the Worshippers
And the Most Ascetic of the Ascetics
And may Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you
And His prayers and greetings

Arabic text: أَنْتَ مُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامِ عَلَى حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
Translation: You are the one who fed food out of love for Him to the needy, the orphan, and the captive

Arabic text: لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا تُرِيدُ مِنْهُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
Translation: For the Face of Allah, not desiring from them any reward or gratitude
And concerning you Allah the Exalted revealed:

Arabic text: وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ
Translation: "And they give others preference over themselves, even though they are in need

Arabic text: وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
Translation: And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful"
And you are the one who suppresses anger
And pardons people
And Allah loves the doers of good

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الصَّابِرُ فِيْ الْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ وَحِيْنَ الْبَأْسِ
Translation: And you are the patient one in adversity, hardship, and in battle
And you are the one who divides equally
And the just one among the subjects

Arabic text: وَالْعَالِمُ بِحُدُودِ اللَّهِ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْبَرِيَّةِ
Translation: And the most knowledgeable about Allah's limits among all creation

Arabic text: وَاللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَخْبَرَ عَمَّا أَوْلاَكَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ بِقَوْلِهِ
Translation: And Allah the Exalted has informed about what He bestowed upon you of His favor by His saying:

Arabic text: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا
Translation: "Is one who is a believer like one who is defiantly disobedient?
They are not equal
As for those who believed and did righteous deeds

Arabic text: فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْمَأْوَى نُزُلًا بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُونَ
Translation: For them are the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do"
And you are the one specially endowed with knowledge of the revelation
And the judgment of interpretation
And the explicit declaration of the Messenger
And yours are the witnessed positions
And the famous stations
And the days remembered
The day of Badr and the day of the Confederates

Arabic text: إِذْ زَاغَتِ الْاَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ
Translation: When eyes shifted and hearts reached the throats
And you thought of Allah assumption [of the worst]

Arabic text: هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوْا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا
Translation: There the believers were tested and severely shaken

Arabic text: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِيْنَ فِيْ قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ
Translation: And when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease said:

Arabic text: مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
Translation: "Allah and His Messenger promised us nothing but delusion"
And when a faction of them said:

Arabic text: يَا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوْا
Translation: "O people of Yathrib, there is no place for you [here], so return"
And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet
Saying, "Indeed, our houses are exposed"

Arabic text: وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِنْ يُرِيدُوْنَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
Translation: While they were not exposed. They only wished to flee
And Allah the Exalted said:
"And when the believers saw the confederates, they said:
'This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us
And Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth'
And it increased them only in faith and submission"
So you killed their champion
And defeated their assembly
And Allah repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage
Not having obtained any good
And Allah spared the believers of fighting
And Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

Arabic text: وَيَوْمَ أُحُدٍ إِذْ يُصْعِدُوْنَ وَلَا يَلْوُونَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ
Translation: And the day of Uhud, when they were climbing and not looking at anyone
While the Messenger was calling them from behind

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ تَذُودُ بِهِمُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
Translation: And you were driving away the polytheists from the Prophet
To the right and to the left

Arabic text: حَتَّىٰ رَدَّهُمُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْكُمَا خَائِفِينَ
Translation: Until Allah the Exalted repelled them from you both in fear
And through you He supported those who had abandoned [the battle]

Arabic text: وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ عَلَى مَا نَطَقَ بِهِ التَّنْزِيلُ
Translation: And the day of Hunayn, as spoken of in the revelation:

Arabic text: إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْكُمْ شَيْئًا
Translation: When your great numbers impressed you, but they did not avail you at all
And the earth was constricted for you despite its vastness
Then you turned back, retreating

Arabic text: ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
Translation: Then Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers
And the believers were you and those with you
And your uncle al-Abbas was calling to those who had fled:
"O companions of Surah al-Baqarah
O people of the Pledge of the Tree"

Arabic text: حَتَّىٰ اسْتَجَابَ لَهُ قَوْمٌ قَدْ كَفَيْتَهُمُ الْمَؤُونَةَ
Translation: Until a group responded to him, whom you had relieved of the burden
And undertook their assistance instead of them
So they returned having despaired of reward
Hoping for Allah the Exalted's promise of repentance
And that is the saying of Allah, exalted be His remembrance:

Arabic text: ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ
Translation: "Then Allah will accept repentance after that for whom He wills"
And you attained the degree of patience
And won the great reward

Arabic text: وَيَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ إِذْ أَظْهَرَ اللَّهُ خَوَرَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ
Translation: And on the day of Khaybar, when Allah exposed the cowardice of the hypocrites
And cut off the root of the disbelievers
And praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

Arabic text: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوْا عَاهَدُوْا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْاَدْبَارَ
Translation: And they had already promised Allah before not to turn their backs in retreat
And the promise of Allah will be questioned about
My master, you are the conclusive proof
And the clear path
And the abundant blessing
And the illuminating evidence

Arabic text: فَهَنِيئًا لَكَ بِمَا آتَاكَ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلٍ
Translation: So congratulations to you for what Allah has given you of His bounty
And ruin to your hater full of ignorance

Arabic text: شَهِدْتَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: You witnessed with the Prophet, may Allah bless him and his family
All his wars and battles
Carrying the banner before him
And striking with the sword in front of him
Then due to your well-known resolve
And your insight in affairs
He made you a commander in various situations
And no one was ever made commander over you

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ أَمْرٍ صَدَّكَ عَنْ إِمْضَاءِ عَزْمِكَ فِيْهِ التُّقَىٰ
Translation: And how many times did piety prevent you from carrying out your resolve in a matter
While others in similar situations followed their desires

Arabic text: فَظَنَّ الْجَاهِلُونَ أَنَّكَ عَجَزْتَ عَمَّا إِلَيْهِ انْتَهَىٰ
Translation: So the ignorant thought that you were unable to do what they did

Arabic text: ضَلَّ وَاللَّهِ الظَّانُّ لِذٰلِكَ وَمَا اهْتَدَىٰ
Translation: By Allah, such a thinker has gone astray and is not guided

Arabic text: وَلَقَدْ أَوْضَحْتَ مَا أَشْكَلَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ تَوَهَّمَ وَامْتَرَىٰ
Translation: And you have made clear what was confusing about that to whoever was suspicious or doubted
By your saying, may Allah's blessings be upon you:

Arabic text: قَدْ يَرَىٰ الْحُوَّلُ الْقُلَّبُ وَجْهَ الْحِيْلَةِ
Translation: "Many a shrewd, quick-witted person sees the way of trickery
But there is a barrier of God-consciousness before it
So he abandons it knowingly

Arabic text: وَيَنْتَهِزُ فُرْصَتَهَا مَنْ لَا حَرِيجَةَ لَهُ فِيْ الدِّينِ
Translation: While one who has no religious restraint seizes its opportunity"
You spoke the truth, by Allah, and the falsifiers are losers
And when the two covenant-breakers plotted against you
And said: "We want to perform Umrah"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتَ لَهُمَا لَعَمْرُكُمَا مَا تُرِيدَانِ الْعُمْرَةَ
Translation: You said to them: "By your lives, you do not want Umrah
But you want treachery"
So you took their pledge of allegiance
And renewed the covenant
But they persisted in hypocrisy

Arabic text: فَلَمَّا نَبَّهْتَهُمَا عَلَى فِعْلِهِمَا أَغْفَلَا وَعَادَا وَمَا انْتَفَعَا
Translation: And when you made them aware of their actions, they ignored and returned and did not benefit
And the end of their affair was loss
Then the people of Syria followed them
So you marched against them after offering them excuses
While they did not follow the religion of truth
And did not ponder the Quran
A reckless rabble gone astray

Arabic text: وَبِالَّذِيْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ فِيكَ كَافِرُونَ
Translation: Disbelieving in what was revealed to Muhammad concerning you
And supporting those who opposed you
While Allah has commanded to follow you
And called upon the believers to support you
And said, Mighty and Majestic:
"O you who have believed
Fear Allah and be with the truthful"
My master, through you the truth became manifest
Though the people had rejected it
And you made clear the Sunnahs after they had been obliterated and obscured

Arabic text: فَلَكَ سَابِقَةُ الْجِهَادِ عَلَى تَصْدِيقِ التَّنْزِيلِ
Translation: For you have the precedence of striving to confirm the revelation

Arabic text: وَلَكَ فَضِيلَةُ الْجِهَادِ عَلَى تَحْقِيقِ التَّأْوِيلِ
Translation: And you have the excellence of striving to verify the interpretation

Arabic text: وَعَدُوُّكَ عَدُوُّ اللَّهِ جَاحِدٌ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ
Translation: And your enemy is the enemy of Allah, denying the Messenger of Allah
Calling to falsehood and ruling unjustly

Arabic text: وَيَتَأَمَّرُ غَاصِبًا وَيَدْعُوْ حِزْبَهُ إِلَى النَّارِ
Translation: Usurping authority and calling his party to the Fire
While Ammar was fighting and calling out between the two armies:
"Paradise! Paradise! To Paradise!"

Arabic text: وَلَمَّا اسْتَسْقَىٰ فَسُقِيَ اللَّبَنَ كَبَّرَ وَقَالَ
Translation: And when he asked for a drink and was given milk, he said Allahu Akbar and said:

Arabic text: قَالَ لِيْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: "The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, said to me:

Arabic text: آخِرُ شَرَابِكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا ضَيَاحٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ
Translation: 'Your last drink in this world will be a mixture of milk
And you will be killed by the transgressing party'"
Then Abu al-Adiyah al-Fazari confronted him and killed him
So upon Abu al-Adiyah be the curse of Allah
And the curse of His angels and all His messengers
And upon those who drew their swords against you
And against whom you drew your sword
O Commander of the Faithful

Arabic text: مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
Translation: From among the polytheists and hypocrites until the Day of Judgment
And upon those who were pleased with what grieved you

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكْرَهْهُ وَأَغْمَضَ عَيْنَهُ وَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ
Translation: And did not detest it, and closed their eyes and did not object

Arabic text: أَوْ أَعَانَ عَلَيْكَ بِيَدٍ أَوْ لِسَانٍ
Translation: Or helped against you with hand or tongue
Or held back from supporting you
Or abandoned the struggle alongside you
Or belittled your excellence
And denied your right

Arabic text: أَوْ عَدَلَ بِكَ مَنْ جَعَلَكَ اللَّهُ أَوْلَى بِهِ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ
Translation: Or equated with you those whom Allah made you worthier of than themselves

Arabic text: وَصَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
Translation: And may Allah's blessings be upon you and His mercy and His blessings
And His peace and His greetings
And upon the Imams from your purified family
Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Glorious
And the most astonishing matter
And the most terrible calamity after denying your right

Arabic text: غَصْبُ الصِّدِّيقَةِ الطَّاهِرَةِ الزَّهْرَاءِ سَيِّدَةِ النِّسَاءِ فَدَكًا
Translation: Was the usurpation from the truthful, purified Fatima, the lady of women, of Fadak
And the rejection of your testimony and the testimony of the two masters, your descendants
The progeny of the Chosen One, may Allah's blessings be upon you all

Arabic text: وَقَدْ أَعْلَى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَى الْأُمَّةِ دَرَجَتَكُمْ
Translation: While Allah the Exalted had elevated your rank above the community
And raised your position
And made clear your excellence and nobility above the worlds
So He removed from you impurity and purified you with a thorough purification
Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said:
"Indeed, mankind was created anxious
When evil touches him, impatient
And when good touches him, withholding
Except the praying ones"
So Allah the Exalted made an exception for His chosen Prophet

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ يَا سَيِّدَ الْاَوْصِيَاءِ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْخَلْقِ
Translation: And you, O Master of Successors, from all creation

Arabic text: فَمَا أَعْمَهَ مَنْ ظَلَمَكَ عَنِ الْحَقِّ
Translation: How blind was the one who wronged you from the truth

Arabic text: ثُمَّ أَفْرَضُوكَ سَهْمَ ذَوِيْ الْقُرْبَىٰ مَكْرًا
Translation: Then they rejected your share of the close relatives out of deceit
And diverted it from its rightful recipients unjustly

Arabic text: فَلَمَّا آلَ الْاَمْرُ إِلَيْكَ أَجْرَيْتَهُمْ عَلَى مَا أَجْرَيَا
Translation: But when the authority came to you, you conducted it as they had conducted it

Arabic text: رَغْبَةً عَنْهُمَا بِمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ لَكَ
Translation: Turning away from their practices, desiring what Allah has for you

Arabic text: فَأَشْبَهَتْ مِحْنَتُكَ بِهِمَا مِحَنَ الْاَنْبِيَاءِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ
Translation: So your trials with them resembled the trials of the Prophets, peace be upon them
In their isolation and lack of supporters

Arabic text: وَأَشْبَهْتَ فِيْ الْبَيَاتِ عَلَى الْفِرَاشِ الذَّبِيحَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
Translation: And in your sleeping on the bed [of the Prophet], you resembled the sacrifice [Ismail], peace be upon him
When you responded as he responded

Arabic text: وَأَطَعْتَ كَمَا أَطَاعَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ صَابِرًا مُحْتَسِبًا
Translation: And obeyed as Ismail obeyed, patient and seeking reward

Arabic text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّيْ أَرَىٰ فِيْ الْمَنَامِ أَنِّيْ أَذْبَحُكَ
Translation: When he said to him: "O my son, I have seen in a dream that I am sacrificing you
So consider what you think"

Arabic text: قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ
Translation: He said: "O my father, do what you are commanded

Arabic text: سَتَجِدُنِيْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
Translation: You will find me, if Allah wills, of the patient"

Arabic text: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَمَّا أَبَاتَكَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And likewise you, when the Prophet, may Allah bless him and his family, had you sleep in his bed
And commanded you to lie in his place
Protecting him with your life
You hastened to obey him
Preparing yourself for death
So Allah the Exalted thanked you for your obedience

Arabic text: وَأَبَانَ عَنْ جَمِيلِ فِعْلِكَ بِقَوْلِهِ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ
Translation: And revealed the beauty of your deed in His saying, exalted be His remembrance:

Arabic text: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْرِيْ نَفْسَهُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاةِ اللَّهِ
Translation: "And among the people is he who sells himself seeking the pleasure of Allah"
Then your trial on the day of Siffin
When the Qurans were raised as a trick and deception
So doubt appeared
And truth was abandoned
And conjecture was followed

Arabic text: أَشْبَهَتْ مِحْنَةَ هَارُونَ إِذْ أَمَّرَهُ مُوْسَى عَلَى قَوْمِهِ فَتَفَرَّقُوْا عَنْهُ
Translation: Resembled the trial of Aaron when Moses appointed him over his people, but they dispersed from him
And Aaron called to them and said:

Arabic text: يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحْمٰنُ
Translation: "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful
So follow me and obey my command"

Arabic text: قَالُوْاْ لَنْ نَبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوْسَى
Translation: They said: "We will not cease being devoted to it until Moses returns to us"

Arabic text: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَمَّا رُفِعَتِ الْمَصَاحِفُ قُلْتَ
Translation: And likewise you, when the Qurans were raised, you said:

Arabic text: يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهَا وَخُدِعْتُمْ
Translation: "O people, you are only being tested by them and deceived"
But they disobeyed you and opposed you
And demanded the appointment of two arbitrators

Arabic text: فَأَبَيْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَتَبَرَّأْتَ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ وَفَوَّضْتَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ
Translation: So you refused them and disassociated yourself to Allah from their actions and delegated it to them
And when the truth became clear
And the wrong was exposed
And they acknowledged their error and deviation from the right path
They differed afterwards

Arabic text: وَأَلْزَمُوكَ عَلَى سَفَهِ التَّحْكِيمِ الَّذِيْ أَبَيْتَهُ وَأَحَبُّوهُ
Translation: And held you to the foolish arbitration which you had refused but they desired
They justified their sin which they had committed
While you were on a path of insight and guidance
And they were on paths of misguidance and blindness
They persisted in hypocrisy
And in error they wavered
Until Allah made them taste the evil consequence of their affair

Arabic text: فَأَمَاتَ بِسَيْفِكَ مَنْ عَانَدَكَ فَشَقِيَ وَهَوَىٰ
Translation: So He killed by your sword whoever opposed you, thus was wretched and fell
And brought to life through your proof whoever was fortunate, and thus was guided
May Allah's blessings be upon you, coming and going
And remaining and departing
For no praiser can encompass your description
Nor can any critic diminish your excellence
You are the most excellent of creation in worship
And the most sincere of them in asceticism
And the most defensive of them for the religion
You established the limits of Allah with your utmost effort
And broke the armies of the deviators with your sword
You extinguished the flames of wars with your fingertips
And tore the veils of doubts with your eloquence

Arabic text: وَتَكْشِفُ لَبْسَ الْبَاطِلِ عَنْ صَرِيحِ الْحَقِّ
Translation: And removed the confusion of falsehood from pure truth

Arabic text: لَا تَأْخُذُكَ فِيْ اللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
Translation: The blame of any blamer did not deter you in the cause of Allah

Arabic text: وَفِيْ مَدْحِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى لَكَ غِنَىٰ
Translation: And in Allah the Exalted's praise of you is sufficiency
From the praise of praisers and the commendation of describers
Allah the Exalted said:

Arabic text: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوْا مَا عَاهَدُوْا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: "Among the believers are men who have been true to what they promised Allah

Arabic text: فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوْا تَبْدِيلًا
Translation: Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow, and among them is he who awaits, and they did not alter in the least"

Arabic text: وَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ أَنْ قَتَلْتَ النَّاكِثِينَ وَالْقَاسِطِينَ وَالْمَارِقِينَ
Translation: And when you saw that you had killed the oath-breakers, the unjust, and the deviators

Arabic text: وَصَدَقَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَعْدَهُ
Translation: And the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, had fulfilled his promise to you
And you fulfilled his covenant, you said:

Arabic text: أَمَا آنَ أَنْ تُخْضَبَ هٰذِهِ مِنْ هٰذِهِ
Translation: "Is it not time for this [beard] to be dyed from this [head]?
Or when will its most wretched one be sent forth?"

Arabic text: وَاثِقًا بِأَنَّكَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكَ
Translation: Confident that you were upon clear evidence from your Lord
And insight in your affair
Coming to Allah
Rejoicing in your transaction that you made with Him
And that is the great attainment

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَوْصِيَاءِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ
Translation: O Allah, curse the killers of Your Prophets and the successors of Your Prophets
With all Your curses
And make them feel the heat of Your Fire
And curse those who usurped Your guardian's right
And denied his covenant

Arabic text: وَجَحَدَهُ بَعْدَ الْيَقِينِ وَالْاِقْرَارِ بِالْوِلَايَةِ لَهُ
Translation: And rejected him after certainty and acknowledgment of his guardianship
On the day You perfected for him the religion
O Allah, curse the killers of the Commander of the Faithful
And those who wronged him and their followers and supporters
O Allah, curse the oppressors of Husayn and his killers
And those who followed his enemy and his supporters
And those who were pleased with his killing and those who abandoned him, with a severe curse

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ ظَلَمَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, curse the first oppressor who wronged the family of Muhammad
And those who prevented them their rights

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ خُصَّ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ وَغَاصِبٍ لِأٓلِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِاللَّعْنِ
Translation: O Allah, specifically curse the first oppressor and usurper against the family of Muhammad with Your curse

Arabic text: وَكُلَّ مُسْتَنٍّ بِمَا سَنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
Translation: And everyone who followed his practices until the Day of Resurrection

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets

Arabic text: وَعَلَى عَلِيٍّ سَيِّدِ الْوَصِيِّينَ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: And upon Ali, the Master of Successors, and his purified family
And make us among those who hold fast to them
And through their guardianship among the successful and secure

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْنَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
Translation: Those upon whom there is no fear, nor do they grieve
